assay: bulk polyA mRNA-seq, NovaSeq X Plus PE150, human forearm flexor skeletal muscle (S2.2.p1)
primary_estimand: Within-patient change in skeletal-muscle gene expression after 12 months of personalized resistance-based muscle therapy versus baseline in dialysis patients (S2.1.p1, S2.2.p1)

factors.subject: patients GHD28, GHD35, GHD42, GHD45, GHD58

sample_inclusion: Only patients who consented to the optional biopsy (S2.1.3.p1); RNA-seq n = 5 patients x 2 visits (FIG1, FIG4 legend)
repeated_measure_unit: patient (pre/post paired biopsies); GEO deposits 2 libraries per patient-visit (B/C or A/C)
planned_contrasts: Visit-2 (post 12 mo exercise) vs Visit-1 (baseline), paired by patient (S3.1.p1, FIG1, FIG4; paper reports no DEG count)

paper_threshold.note: No DEG threshold stated. RNA-seq was analysed on the vendor NovoMagic platform (S2.2.p1, S3.1.p1); the only stated rule is unpaired two-tailed Student's t-test p < 0.05 for IHC/IF quantification (S2.4.p1).

paper_method: Vendor (NovoMagic) pipeline, method unstated; GO enrichment of upregulated genes (FIG1); per-gene display of 20 oxidation/energy genes (FIG4A)

go_terms_up: generation of precursor metabolites and energy
energy derivation by oxidation of organic compounds
